newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson in row in Lebanon over 940 mln SKR deal.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson in row in Lebanon over 940 mln SKR deal.

text.p: Swedish telecoms giant LM Ericsson is in a row with Lebanon's telecommunications authority over part of a 940 million crown contract that involved setting up 170,000 new telephone lines, a Swedish newspaper reported on Monday.
Business daily Dagens Industri said it understood the situation between the partners at the moment was critical and there was a risk the row would have to go to arbitration.
The telecoms authority asserts that Ericsson carried out work worth 147 million dollars as stated in the contrat but then did more work, using its own resources.
But Ericsson asserts that the Lebanese authorities asked for more than was stated in the contract and therefore owes Ericsson more.
Alcatel and Siemens, which are Ericsson's rivals in the Lebanese telecom market, have also had disputes with the authority, Dagens Industri said.
